entities.summary: Shingo Murakami (b. 1982-01-26, Takatsuki) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Takatsuki and Japan. Known in the fields of japan, composers & musicians, asia.
